description: MFS with tips, overtime, senior age, and car-loan interest — only the car-loan deduction survives (G5).
derivation: Tips, overtime, and the senior deduction require MFJ if married. Car-loan interest has no joint-return rule; MFS uses the $100,000 threshold. MAGI $80,000 is under that start, so the $2,500 of interest is allowed in full.
